name: R3-eval-RM-Bench
description: Benchmark for evaluating reward models by comparing model-assigned scores or rankings of model outputs against human preference judgments. It measures how well a reward model predicts human preferences across generated responses, typically using pairwise comparisons and aggregate agreement metrics. The benchmark is aimed at assessing alignment and preference-capture quality of reward models used in RLHF and related pipelines.
evaluation_method: pairwise_accuracy (agreement with human preferences) / correlation with human judgments
general_score_metric: pairwise_accuracy / Spearman correlation with human rankings
reputation: Used within the reward-modeling and alignment research community; niche but relevant for RM/RLHF evaluation.
